findings.label: decisionLog always wiped on step
findings.detail: updateFromSimResult unconditionally sets decisionLog: [] on every engine step. The endMission store action only accepts MissionScore, not the log. engine.getDecisionLog() is never called in the hook's endMission(). The debrief screen (Phase 9) will find an empty log unless the endMission action signature and the hook are updated before that phase.

findings.label: /debrief guarded only by RequireSetup, not RequireMission
findings.detail: A user who has selected a planet and crew but never started a mission can navigate directly to /debrief. Confirm whether this is intentional before implementing the debrief screen.
